# Mastodon Connector for Muse

A Muse agent skill that reads and writes your Mastodon account on any instance: verify the connection, list your toots and followers, publish toots with native scheduling, and upload media. Publishing is a public write — confirm the text and visibility first. Connects via OAuth or a personal token from your own instance; the credential is sent only to your instance host, kept in Muse's secure vault. No secrets in the repo.
